title: Stack Tower
tagline: Tap to stack. One perfect drop and you cannot stop.
hook: The game is already running when the ad appears. A block swings across the screen, a pulsing ring and a bouncing finger say where to tap, and the first tap pays off at once with a sound, a squash, a score pop and a color change.
coreLoop: A block swings over the tower. Tap to drop it. The overhang is cut off and falls away, so the tower gets narrower with every mistake. A perfect drop snaps into place, keeps the block full size and builds a combo that grows the block back.

levers.name: First five seconds
levers.why: Most players who leave do it in the first three seconds, so the ad must be playable before they decide.
levers.how: No title screen. The game runs on load, the hint pulses, and the finger marker shakes if nobody taps for 2.5 seconds.

levers.name: Instant feedback
levers.why: Every tap needs a visible, audible and tactile answer, or the mechanic feels dead.
levers.how: Landing squash, score pop, score bump, synthesized note and a short vibration. A perfect drop adds a ring, sparkles and a camera punch that grows with the combo.

levers.name: Combo and regrow
levers.why: A streak makes skill visible and gives a reason to keep going.
levers.how: Each perfect drop raises the combo. The notes climb a pentatonic scale, and from the third perfect drop the block grows back toward full size.

levers.name: Goal gradient
levers.why: People speed up when they can see the finish line.
levers.how: A progress bar fills toward 14 blocks, with ALMOST THERE at four blocks to go and ONE MORE at the last block.

levers.name: Second chance
levers.why: A failure that ends the ad loses the player, and one that offers a retry keeps them.
levers.how: The first fail shows a TRY AGAIN button next to the install button. The second fail leaves only the install button.

levers.name: Reward and exit
levers.why: The end card is where the install happens, so it must feel like a prize.
levers.how: Stars animate in, the score is shown, a teaser line announces Level 2, and the PLAY LEVEL 2 button is the biggest element on the screen.

events.name: impression
events.meaning: The ad is ready and visible, and the game starts.

events.name: first_tap
events.meaning: Milliseconds from start to the first tap. The key hook metric.

events.name: drop
events.meaning: A block was placed. Carries kind (perfect or cut), level and combo.

events.name: streak
events.meaning: A combo of three or more perfect drops.

events.name: idle_nudge
events.meaning: Nobody tapped for 2.5 seconds and the hint started to shake.

events.name: milestone
events.meaning: The halfway block was placed, and the rhythm break played.

events.name: fail
events.meaning: The block missed the tower. Carries level and score.

events.name: retry
events.meaning: The player used the second chance.

events.name: end_card
events.meaning: The end card is shown. Carries outcome, score, stars and level.

events.name: cta_click
events.meaning: The install button was pressed. Carries where it was pressed.

instant-motion.note: The block is already swinging on load, with no title screen.

text-hook.note: The caption Can you stack 14 shows over the tower and slides away after the first tap.

one-control.note: A single tap anywhere. A pulsing marker shows where.

first-reward.note: The first drop squashes the block, pops a score and plays a note, even when it is cut.

pattern-interrupt.note: At the halfway block a burst, a zoom punch and a chord break the rhythm. The swing also speeds up every block.

variable-reward.note: Perfect drops build a combo with rising notes, and from the third one the block grows back.

open-loop.note: A progress bar fills toward 14 blocks and the last four blocks get a teaser message.

near-miss.note: ALMOST THERE and ONE MORE appear near the goal. A loss at block 8 or higher still earns two stars.

instant-retry.note: The first failure offers TRY AGAIN beside the install button.

sound-haptics.note: Synthesized notes and short vibrations on every drop, and audio starts only after the first tap.

cliffhanger-end.note: Animated stars, then a teaser line about Level 2 and a PLAY LEVEL 2 button. Level 2 is a teaser: the button goes to the store link.

measured.note: Events include first_tap, streak, milestone and cta_click, all listed on this page.
